passages.text: Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God, for you have stumbled by your iniquity.
passages.sermon:
Israel, you have sinned.
You have turned away from God.
The LORD is your God.
Return to the LORD.
You have fallen because of your sin.
passages.original: שׁ֚וּבָה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּ֥י כָשַׁ֖לְתָּ בַּעֲוֺנֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Bring your confessions and return to the LORD. Say to Him: “Take away all our iniquity and receive us graciously, that we may present the fruit of our lips.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God calls Israel to return to Him.
God wants Israel to confess their sins.
God says, “Bring your words with you.”
God says, “Return to Me.”
Say to God, “Take away all our iniquity.”
Say to God, “Receive us graciously.”
Say to God, “We will offer the fruit of our lips.”
passages.original: קְח֤וּ עִמָּכֶם֙ דְּבָרִ֔ים וְשׁ֖וּבוּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה אִמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו כָּל־ תִּשָּׂ֤א עָוֺן֙ וְקַח־ ט֔וֹב וּֽנְשַׁלְּמָ֥ה פָרִ֖ים שְׂפָתֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: Assyria will not save us, nor will we ride on horses. We will never again say, ‘Our gods!’ to the work of our own hands. For in You the fatherless find compassion.”
passages.sermon:
Israel speaks to God.
Israel says, “Assyria will not save us.
We will not ride on horses.
We will not call the work of our hands ‘our gods’ again.
You, LORD, show compassion to the fatherless.”
passages.original: אַשּׁ֣וּר׀ לֹ֣א יוֹשִׁיעֵ֗נוּ עַל־ סוּס֙ לֹ֣א נִרְכָּ֔ב וְלֹא־ נֹ֥אמַר ע֛וֹד אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ לְמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֵ֑ינוּ אֲשֶׁר־ בְּךָ֖ יְרֻחַ֥ם יָתֽוֹם׃

passages.text: I will heal their apostasy; I will freely love them, for My anger has turned away from them.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God promises to heal their turning away from Him.
God says He will love them freely.
God’s anger has turned away from them.
passages.original: אֶרְפָּא֙ מְשׁ֣וּבָתָ֔ם אֹהֲבֵ֖ם נְדָבָ֑ה כִּ֛י שָׁ֥ב אַפִּ֖י מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like the lily and take root like the cedars of Lebanon.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God promises to help Israel.
God says, "I will be like dew to Israel."
Dew brings life and refreshes the land.
Israel will blossom like a lily.
A lily is beautiful and grows quickly.
Israel will take root like the cedars of Lebanon.
Cedars of Lebanon are strong and deep-rooted.
God will make Israel strong and full of life.
passages.original: אֶהְיֶ֤ה כַטַּל֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִפְרַ֖ח כַּשּֽׁוֹשַׁנָּ֑ה וְיַ֥ךְ שָׁרָשָׁ֖יו כַּלְּבָנֽוֹן׃

passages.text: His shoots will sprout, and his splendor will be like the olive tree, his fragrance like the cedars of Lebanon.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Israel.
God promises to bless Israel.
Israel’s shoots will grow and spread.
Israel’s beauty will be like the olive tree.
Israel’s fragrance will be like the cedars of Lebanon.
passages.original: יֵֽלְכוּ֙ יֹֽנְקוֹתָ֔יו וִיהִ֥י כַזַּ֖יִת הוֹד֑וֹ וְרֵ֥יחַֽ ל֖וֹ כַּלְּבָנֽוֹן׃

passages.text: They will return and dwell in his shade; they will grow grain and blossom like the vine. His renown will be like the wine of Lebanon.
passages.sermon:
God cares for Israel.
God protects Israel.
People will return to God.
They will live under God's protection.
They will have plenty of grain.
They will grow strong and flourish like a vine.
God will make them fruitful.
God will make their reputation great.
Their renown will be like the wine of Lebanon.
The wine of Lebanon is famous and excellent.
God will give Israel honor and blessing.
passages.original: יָשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י בְצִלּ֔וֹ יְחַיּ֥וּ דָגָ֖ן וְיִפְרְח֣וּ כַגָּ֑פֶן זִכְר֖וֹ כְּיֵ֥ין לְבָנֽוֹן׃ס

passages.text: O Ephraim, what have I to do anymore with idols? It is I who answer and watch over him. I am like a flourishing cypress; your fruit comes from Me.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Ephraim.
God says, “Ephraim, I have nothing to do with idols anymore.”
God answers Ephraim.
God watches over Ephraim.
God is like a flourishing cypress tree.
All fruit comes from God.
passages.original: אֶפְרַ֕יִם מַה־ לִּ֥י ע֖וֹד לָֽעֲצַבִּ֑ים אֲנִ֧י עָנִ֣יתִי וַאֲשׁוּרֶ֗נּוּ אֲנִי֙ כִּבְר֣וֹשׁ רַֽעֲנָ֔ן מִמֶּ֖נִּי פֶּרְיְךָ֥ נִמְצָֽא׃

passages.text: Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; whoever is discerning, let him know them. For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them but the rebellious stumble in them.
passages.sermon:
A wise person understands these things.
A discerning person knows them.
The ways of the LORD are right.
Righteous people walk in the ways of the LORD.
Rebellious people stumble in the ways of the LORD.
passages.original: מִ֤י חָכָם֙ וְיָ֣בֵֽן אֵ֔לֶּה נָב֖וֹן וְיֵֽדָעֵ֑ם כִּֽי־ יְשָׁרִ֞ים דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה וְצַדִּקִים֙ יֵ֣לְכוּ בָ֔ם וּפֹשְׁעִ֖ים יִכָּ֥שְׁלוּ בָֽם׃
